    orcid: "0000-0002-3396-4549"

  - path: modal

extensions:
  modal:
    fade: true
    centred: true
---

A div whose identifier starts with `modal-` becomes the dialog, its first heading becomes the title, and a horizontal rule separates the footer from the body.

```markdown
{{{< modal toggle target=modal-hello label="Say hello" >}}}

::: {#modal-hello size=lg}
## Hello

The body, written as ordinary markdown.

---

{{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}}
:::
```

{{< modal toggle target=modal-hello label="Say hello" >}}

::: {#modal-hello size=lg}
## Hello

The body, written as ordinary markdown.

---

{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}
:::

A plain link to the same identifier is expanded into a toggle too, so a modal can be opened from [the middle of a sentence](#modal-hello).

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-modal/>.
